# IDEAS/RePEc

> A comprehensive open-access research repository and bibliographic database indexing economics and finance literature, including working papers, journals, books, software, and author profiles with research impact rankings.

IDEAS/RePEc is the largest aggregated economics research database, maintained by Christian Zimmermann at the University of Munich. It provides researchers with tools for discovering, sharing, and tracking economic research across institutional archives and journal publishers worldwide.

## Core Research Collections

- [Economics Paper Series](https://ideas.repec.org/i/p.html): Directory of working paper series indexed in the IDEAS/RePEc database
- [Economics Journals](https://ideas.repec.org/i/a.html): Directory of economics journals with rankings and impact factors
- [Economics Book Series](https://ideas.repec.org/i/b.html): Collection of economics book series and monographs in the database
- [Economics Book Chapter Series](https://ideas.repec.org/i/h.html): Index of economics book chapters from academic publishers and institutions
- [Economics Software](https://ideas.repec.org/i/c.html): Repository of economics software and computational tools for research

## Research Impact & Rankings

- [Economics Rankings](https://ideas.repec.org/top): Research impact rankings for authors, institutions and journals
- [Authors](https://ideas.repec.org/i/e.html): Author directory with profiles, rankings and registration services
- [Database Statistics](https://ideas.repec.org/stats.html): Statistics and metrics on IDEAS/RePEc database content and usage

## Research Discovery & Navigation

- [JEL Classification System](https://ideas.repec.org/j): JEL classification system for browsing economics research by subject
- [Virtual Seminar Calendar](https://ideas.repec.org/v): Calendar of virtual seminars in economics across various research fields
- [Central Index](https://ideas.repec.org): Central index of economics and finance research including papers, articles and code

## User Services & Tools

- [MyIDEAS](https://ideas.repec.org/cgi-bin/myideas.cgi): Personalized user service for bibliography management and author tracking
- [RePEc Network Services](https://ideas.repec.org/services.html): Overview of RePEc network services and participating repositories

## Documentation & Support

- [Help & FAQ](https://ideas.repec.org/help.html): FAQ and guides for using IDEAS and submitting research to RePEc
- [RePEc Archive Tutorial](https://ideas.repec.org/stepbystep.html): Tutorial for setting up and managing a RePEc institutional archive
- [Corrections & Metadata Management](https://ideas.repec.org/corrections.html): Guide for submitting corrections and managing metadata in IDEAS/RePEc
- [Contact & Email Policy](https://ideas.repec.org/email.html): Contact guidelines and email policy for IDEAS/RePEc services

## Optional

- [Credits](https://ideas.repec.org/credits.html): Acknowledgments of contributors and team members to IDEAS/RePEc
- [Christian Zimmermann](https://ideas.repec.org/zimm): Profile of Christian Zimmermann, IDEAS director and RePEc maintainer
